Commentary.Commentary: Pakistan definitely have the firepower to do this against a second-string bowling line up of the hosts. Whether they can do it under pressure remains to be seen. Join us back for the chase in just a bit...

Reeza Hendricks gives an interview on the sidelines. On batting with Faf du Plessis, Hendricks says batting with Faf is always about running quick between the wickets. When asked about what total he and his skipper had in mind, he states that they were going well in the middle and were looking to score 220 runs but ended up short in the end. Reckons that they will have to bowl well. Signs off by saying that the plan with the ball will be to bowl smart and build some pressure as the pitch is a really good one to bat on.

A decent comeback from Pakistan! What looked like a 220 score at one point has been kept down to below 200. Pakistan won the toss and opted to bowl and Cloete was removed early, then Faf du Plessis and Reeza Hendricks joined forces. They hit the ball to all parts of the ground in their 131-run stand. The Pakistani bowlers had no answers to this. The first 15 overs saw 157 runs being scored and only one wicket being lost. Then came the fightback led by Usman Khan. Faf fell and the procession started. The visiting bowlers who are so famously known for their good showing in T20Is showed why and they gave away only 35 in the remaining overs, also picking up 5 wickets. Brilliant way to come back and keep the team in the game on a good batting track.

FOUR! Good intentions brings good results says Mbangwa on air. Another good yorker from Faheem, Phehlukwayo swings hard, gets an inside edge that runs fine on the leg side for a boundary. SOUTH AFRICA END ON 192/6.
Once more, an excellent blockhole delivery. Klaasen can only crank it out to deep cover for a single.
Another good yorker attempted, Andile takes it on the full and drives it to long off for a single.
Andile Phehlukwayo comes out to the crease with just 3 balls remaining.

OUT! Caught! Babar makes no mistake. A full toss outside off, Miller fails to get good timing and hits the ball straight into the hands of the cover fielder inside the ring. A 12-ball struggle comes to an end. Pakistan doing well in the back end of the innings here.
Excellent ball! A yorker length ball outside off and Miller looks to hit it through point but fails to connect. Inside the tramline and not given a wide, rightly so.
A little talk between the skipper and the bowler regarding the field they want.
Good yorker. Klaasen can only jam it away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Faheem Ashraf to bowl the final over.
Shorter one again, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single. Hasan ends with figures of 4-0-34-1.
Fuller one outside off, hit hard down the ground to long off for a single.
Wasted! Klaasen goes for the paddle shot to a yorker length ball and the ball goes off the under edge. Rolls onto the leg side and a quick single is completed.
No ball. Pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single by Miller.  The bowler has been penalized for over-stepping. Free Hit time...
A length ball outside off, worked away to deep mid-wicket for a run by Klaasen to get off the mark.
A shorter one on leg stump line, Miller tries to pull it away but it comes off the inside half and goes to long on for a single.
Heinrich Klaasen walks in next.

OUT! Morris does not disturb the scorers much and walks back for just 1. Back of a length delivery, Morris looks to pull but hits it high on his bat. It goes high up in the air towards deep mid-wicket and Babar Azam takes an easy catch. Half the side back in the hut for South Africa.
Played towards the point fielder by Morris for a single. Again a close call had he hit but again the fielder missed. Chris is off the mark and keeps strike for the next over.

Pulled away off the hips but Miller finds the short fine leg fielder. Only a single can be taken and had the throw been on target that would have been close too as Miller barged into the bowler while completing the single.
Chris Morris comes in at number 6.

OUT! That is how it's done. Shadab showing his teammates. What a brilliant catch! A full toss on middle, Hendricks looks to go over long on, but mistimes his shot and Shadab comes in running and dives a bit to his right to pluck a stunner. Hendricks departs but not before making a splendid 74. Two new batsmen at the crease now.
FOUR! Authoritative shot! Incredible batting from Hendricks this. A length ball outside off, Reeza stands tall and smashes it wide of mid off for a boundary.
FOUR! Fuller one on the  pads, flicked away behind square on the leg side. A tease for Hussain again in the deep but he cannot keep the ball in.

Drops short! A slower bouncer, Hendricks is foxed and mistimes his pull high up in the air. Hussain Talat in the deep square leg region comes in but can't reach the ball. Makes a mess of the stop too and a couple is taken by the batsmen.

Good length delivery on middle and leg, David pushes it through mid-wicket with soft hands and runs the first one quickly. Reeza responds quickly and is able to come back for the second. Good running by the batsmen.
Shorter delivery outside off, Miller punches it towards point and comes back for the second.
Off cutter, a full toss, Hendricks pushes it straight towards long on for a single.
Slower delivery on middle and leg, Reeza pushes it to deep mid-wicket and gets a brace.
Full on middle and off, David pushes it to long on and takes a single.
Starts with a length delivery on middle and leg, Miller looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad. He looks for a single but Reeza says no.
Hasan Ali back into the attack.
No maiden though, a fuller length ball on the pads, flicked away for a single by Miller to deep mid-wicket.
A length ball on middle, Miller defends it back onto the leg side. Fifth dot ball of the over.
David Miller is in.

OUT! What a flying catch! Rassie bags a duck! Back of a length delivery angling into the batsman from 'round the wicket, van der Dussen stays back to push inside the line but gets a thick outside edge behind. Rizwan dives across full length to his right to grab a fantastic catch. A rare flop show by Rassie.
Van Der Dussen defends the first ball off the back foot.
Rassie van der Dussen replaces his skipper.

OUT! Gone this time though! A yorker attempted by Usman, Faf hits it uppishly to mid off. It was flying fast and hard towards mid off, Shoaib Malik though takes the catch really well. The 131-run stand has been brought to an end by Usman. The Proteas' skipper falls after batting brilliantly for his 78.

NOT OUT! There was nothing on it. Looked like the review was taken out of desperation there. A shorter one on middle, Faf looks to pull it away but seems to have missed the ball. The bowler though feels, that there is something on it and asks his captain to review. There is nothing on the Snicko. Pakistan lose the review as well.
Review time. The Pakistan players have gone up for a catch out. It looks to be missing to the naked eye. Now let's wait what the Snicko thinks...
Usman Khan replaces Hussain Talat.
Fuller one on middle, Reeza pushes it to mid-wicket and picks up two with amazing running once more.
FOUR! Brilliant placement. A flatter one outside off, Hendricks cuts it away in the gap behind point for a boundary.
Punched off the back foot for a single by Faf to deep cover.
Flatter one outside off, cut away to deep cover for a single by Hendricks. Brings up 150 for the hosts.
Fuller and quicker this time, hit back hard towards the bowler who makes a half-stop. Single stolen.
SIX! Welcome back Shadab! A flighted ball outside off and Faf du Plessis powers it over long off for a maximum presenting a straight bat. Huge one! This is batting of the highest quality.
Shadab Khan comes back on.

FOUR! Class batting! Back of a length delivery outside off. Hendricks waits for it and opens the face of the bat and guides it away through backward point. Reeza just used the pace of the ball on that one.
Shorter in length, Faf pulls it away on the on side and rotates the strike.
On middle and leg, du Plessis flicks it wide of deep mid-wicket fielder and gets a brace.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Hendricks guides it to third man for a single. Brings up the 2nd T20I fifty for Hendricks.

Slow and shorter in length, Faf looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls on the off side and they take a quick single. Talat has a shy at the stumps at the bowler's end but misses.
FOUR! Beautiful shot. Length delivery outside off, du Plessis keeps his head nice and straight and whacks it through covers for a boundary.
Sprays down the leg side. du Plessis leaves it alone and the umpire signals it as a wide.
Hussain Talat replaces Usman Khan.
A single down to long off to end the over.

A sweep this time, almost bisects the gap between deep square leg and deep mid-wicket for a four but a good effort from the fielder keeps it down to two. Brings up the 100-run stand between these two.
SIX! Huge! A flighted delivery on middle, Du Plessis goes on one knee and smashes it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Flatter one on middle, Faf wanted to pull it over deep mid-wicket but gets an inside edge towards fine leg.
A fuller one on middle, pushed away to deep mid-wicket and it is great running between the wickets as the batsmen pick up two again.
Flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single by Hendricks. Takes him to 49.
Guided down to third man for a single. Reeza will keep strike.
FOUR! Pulled away fine on the leg side for a boundary. A shorter and slower one on the hips, Hendricks just swivels away and pulls it away fine.

NOT OUT! Faf du Plessis is well inside. A length ball outside off, the skipper plays it towards cover off his back foot and sets off. A good effort from Fakhar at cover as he picks the ball up and hits the stumps at the non-striker's end. The batsman drags his bat all the way and the replays show the same once it is taken upstairs.
Run out appeal, a direct hit from Fakhar at the bowler's end. Faf the man in question but doesn't seem to be too fussed about it. Let's see what the replays have to say.
Length ball outside off, punched towards the cover fielder.
Flicked away to the deep square leg region for a single.
SIX! 3 boundaries on the trot! This time Hendricks pulls this one deep over the mid-wicket boundary. It goes way back into the stands. This is poor bowling from Pakistan, too short.

FOUR! Ends the over superbly here. Another one on a length and it is pulled away over deep mid-wicket for a boundary. It brings up the FIFTY for Faf Du Plessis. It is his eighth fifty in this format. This boundary also brings up the 100 for the Proteas. Brilliant batting this from the duo, 15 runs off this over.
SIX! Picks the bones out of this one! A length ball, sits up to be hit and the SA skipper obliges. Du Plessis stands tall and pulls it way over the rope at cow corner.
A length ball outside off, Faf looks to lift it over short fine leg by moving inside the line of the ball but fails to connect bat on ball.
Worked away to fine leg for a single by Reeza.
FOUR! Hendricks stands tall and smashes this half-volley right back over the head of the bowler for a boundary. Goes into the advertising hoardings on a bounce.
A length ball outside off here, Hendricks keeps it out on the off side off his back foot.
Faheem is back on. A change of ends here.
Worked away to deep mid-wicket for a single and RH keeps strike.
In the air... safe! A length ball outside off is lifted over mid off by Hendricks. The ball lands just away from the fielder and a couple of runs are taken.
FOUR LEG BYES! A length ball coming in with the angle and Reeza misses his flick. The ball takes the pad and goes to the fine leg boundary for four leg byes.
A slower one on the pads, the SA skipper is deceived and the ball goes off his thigh pad and fine on the leg side for a leg bye.
Faf mistimes his shot towards the mid-wicket fielder. Dot ball.

Close! A length ball outside off, dropped towards point by Hendricks and he sets off for a quick single. Shadab is quick to pick up the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end. Misses, would have been really tight if he had hit.
Usman Khan is on.
Short and around off, du Plessis rocks back and slaps it through backward point for another couple. All too easy. 11 from this over.
Kneels and sweeps a full ball to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Shot! Width on offer outside off, Faf takes a long stride forward and smashes it with the spin over covers for a boundary. 50-run stand comes up!
Presses ahead and lifts it over covers for a run.
Strides forward and pushes it to covers where the fielder dives and parries it behind mid off. A run taken.
Too full and on middle, Hendricks squeezes it out to sweeper cover for a run.
Shadab Khan introduced into the attack.
Pushed back to long on for a single. Reeza retains strike. Imad finishes his spell with figures of 4-0-23-1.
Short of a length outside off, cut away to deep cover-point for a single.
A flatter and quicker one on a short length, played back to the bowler by du Plessis.

SAFE! Hendricks is back in time. Flicked away off the back foot in the gap wide of long on. The first run is run hard by Hendricks and he comes back for the second. Has to rush and dive to get in the crease. Imad collects the throw and removes the bails. Third umpire is required but replays show us that the dive has saved the batsman. 2 runs added, brilliant running this!
A run out appeal. It has been taken upstairs. Hendricks the man in question but he does not seem to be perturbed. Let's see what the replays have to say...
A length ball on the middle stump line, Hendricks comes down the track and plays it slightly uppishly towards long on. One run taken.
Flatter one on the pads, worked away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flicked away to fine leg for a single. Keeps strike does FDP.

FOUR! Faf du Plessis is playing brilliantly here. Makes room as if to smash this length ball over cover but in the end just angles it down fine to the third man boundary. The man in the deep has no time to come around. Lovely deft batting.
Goes for the same shot once more but this time fails to put bat on ball.

SIX! Incredible from Faf. A length ball outside off and du Plessis goes down on one knee to scoop it over fine leg but seeing the ball outside off he lifts it over third man for a maximum. What an adjustment!
A length ball on off stump line, pushed back to long on for a single by Reeza.
Starts with a full length ball on middle and leg, Reeza tickles it behind square leg and scampers back for the second run. 50 up for South Africa.
Faheem Ashraf is into the attack.
Quicker and flatter again, du Plessis flicks it through mid-wicket and takes a couple. 9 from the over, we're done with the Powerplay, SA are 46/1!
Fires it in on middle, it's deflected to short fine leg for a run.
FOUR! Edgy again! Tossed up ball around off, turning away slightly, Hendricks walks forward and swings his bat across the line. It flies off the outside edge and goes over short third man.
Advances down the track and strokes it down through mid on for a run.
Skidding back in from around middle, du Plessis tries to hit it on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads. Appeal is made but nothing from the umpire.
Goes on the back foot and punches it towards mid off for a run.
Stays back and punches it to covers for one. 12 from the over.
Fullish and on middle, Faf keeps it out off the bottom edge and takes a run as it rolls towards short fine leg.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
FOUR! Take that for power! Short again, it's around off, enough room there for the Protea skipper. He though swings his blade and only manages a top edge. It flies down to third man for a boundary.
FOUR! Just uses the pace of the bowler. A 135 kph short ball around off, du Plessis ramps back and lifts it over the slip cordon for a boundary.
Angling into the batsman, du Plessis tucks it in the gap at mid-wicket and returns for the second run.
Skidding down the leg side, Reeza tries to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. No appeal made and that will be the end of this over, 1 run and a wicket from it.
Risky! Forces a full ball straight to extra cover and rushes across to the other end. The fielder fumbles and made that run easy for the batsmen.
Play and a miss! Flighted and around leg, Faf makes space and tries to play the slog sweep but misses. That was very close to the leg pole.
Quicker one fired in, du Plessis punches it towards mid-wicket.
Arm ball on middle, helped out towards wide mid on.
New batsman is in. It's the skipper - Faf du Plessis.

OUT! Gone, first breakthrough for Pakistan! Flighted delivery, landing full around off and drifting away, Cloete tries to play the drive over the infield but slices it in the air towards cover-point. Fakhar Zaman moves across to his right and takes the catch safely.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and bunts it towards mid on for a quick run. 7 from the over.
Fuller and outside off, pushed straight to covers.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
FOUR! This one is a friendly delivery. On the pads and Reeza cashes in by easily deflecting it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Shortish and on middle, it's helped through backward square leg for one.
Hasan Ali would like to get a breakthrough here.
Beaten! Angling away from the batsman, Cloete pushes inside the line and misses.
Quicker and flatter on off, Cloete plays it down to short third man and steals a run.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Easily done! Tossed up ball around off, Cloete gets forward and neatly lofts it over the infield at mid off for a boundary.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.

Appeal for a run out! Nothing from the square leg umpire. Cloete taps it down to backward point and sets off. Reeza also responds as the fielder throws it to the keeper who in turn breaks the stumps. Hendricks is safely in.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Who will bowl? Spin from both ends. Imad Wasim it is.
SIX! High and handsome! A good end to the over. Full and floated outside off, Reeza takes a stride forward and launches it over covers for a biggie.
Edgy! Walks forward to play the flick but it takes the outside edge and rolls wide of short third man. A single.
FOUR! Poor and punished! Short and wide outside off, Cloete rocks back and whacks it past the point fielder for a cracking boundary.
Moves on the back foot and strokes it towards wide mid off. He crosses for a run and makes it safely as the fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end.
Misses out! On the pads, Hendricks tries to nudge it away but finds the short fine leg fielder.
Turning into the batsman from around off, it's punched out from the crease to point.
Time to get underway. Reeza Hendricks and Gihahn Cloete are the openers for South Africa. Shoaib Malik to kick off proceedings. All set, here we go...

Toss - Birthday boy, Shoaib Malik wins the toss and PAKISTAN WILL FIELD! Injury to Mohammad Hafeez rules him out and Hussain Talat gets a game. For the hosts, they welcome back Chris Morris from injury.

Tests and ODIs both went to the hosts. The Tests were one-sided whereas the 50-over format was competitive. How will the T20Is be? Welcome to the first T20 International between South Africa and Pakistan in Cape Town. The hosts had a scare in the preceding limited-over games and they should be in for some fierce competition coming into this shortest format. The away team are the number 1 ranked team in the world in T20Is. They are on a 9-match winning streak as well. Will Faf du Plessis and co. be the ones to stop this Pakistani juggernaut? Or will Shoaib Malik's men continue their merry ways? We will find out over the next 4 hours. Hello and welcome everyone. Toss and team news just around the corner...
